channel.title: RateLog — Amazon Q Developer changelog
channel.description: Every pricing and usage-limit change RateLog has caught for Amazon Q Developer, dated and sourced — no other tools mixed in.

item.title: Amazon Q Developer — Product sunset announced
item.description: [↓ reduced] AWS announced Amazon Q Developer’s IDE plugins and paid Pro subscription are being sunset in favor of a new agentic IDE, "Kiro" — new Free Tier and Pro signups blocked from May 15, 2026, full end of support April 30, 2027.
